[[File:Dharhan-EGTW.jpg|thumb|[[D'harhan]], the only weapon to survive|200px]]
The '''living weapons''' were the classification of a number of [[Niordi]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] who had volunteered to undergo drastic surgery and be fitted with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] and weapons attached directly to their bodies. The intent was for the Niordi to become artillery units that could move and think like [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. These living weapons were then used against the [[Leech Legion]]s, who were sent to attack the [[Niorde]] [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', pages 59-62, "D'harhan and the Cyborg Warriors"</ref>

Of these living weapons was the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] known as [[D'harhan]]. A colleague of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], D'harhan had accompanied his fellow Niordi scouts to a [[Niordi secret laboratory|secret laboratory]], where he underwent the radical surgical procedures that turned him into a [[Life support/Legends|life-support]] system for a steam-vented, liquid-cooled [[Laser/Legends|laser]] emplacement that was patterned after those of an [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] battle cruiser.<ref name="TEGTW" /> The weapon itself was powered by a [[light-mass core]].<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref> The installation of the machinery required the removal of D'harhan's head, and his [[Brain/Legends|brain]] was flash-frozen and placed within a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] box that was mounted in his breastplate. His [[Heart/Legends|heart]] and [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] were relocated, and other organs were removed,<ref name="TEGTW" /> and the weapon's base was drilled into his collarbones and vertebral column.<ref name="TMA" /> Boba Fett watched the entire procedure, having been brought to the [[Star system/Legends|system]] by [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Nashtah]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

Several of the Niordi scouts who had undergone the surgery had [[Death/Legends|died]] on the table. By the time the surviving subjects were ready, the Leech Legions had overrun Niorde. D'harhan and his [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] cohorts attacked the enemy [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], and he was the only member who survived the encounter.<ref name="TEGTW" />
